firstPartyCooldown.prompt: Draw an isosceles trapezoid with one line of symmetry and one pair of parallel sides.
firstPartyCooldown.teacherAnswer: Teacher checks the single reflection axis and parallel bases.

originalStudentExcerpts: How many do you see? How do you see them? | Description: 7 columns of dots. center is 1 column of 6 dots. working outward to the left and right of the center column, 2 columns of 4 dots, 2 columns of 2 dots, 2 columns of 1 dot. All lined up in the shape of a r

Here is a pair of parallel segments that have the same length. | Add one or more segments to create a figure with only 1 line of symmetry. | Here are two more pairs of parallel segments. Add more segments to make:

Here is a field of dots. | Can you connect the dots to create each of the following shapes? If so, draw the shapes. If not, be prepared to explain your reasoning. | A triangle with only one line of symmetry
